texts.value: Bộ hướng dẫn cho việc tạo ra và lựa chọn các icon được sử dụng trong giao diện người dùng. Các icon của My VNPT cần truyền đạt một cách trực quan các idea, object hoặc action.
System icons are designed to be simple, modern and easy to use on digital interfaces. We aim to create a bold, geometric look in order to achieve consistency across all system icons.
The icon set comes in 2 themes: Line and Filled.
All icons should be drawn on a 24x24px grid frame. Each frame includes key shapes and a 2px padding on all sides as guidance.
Based on our 24x24px grid, we defined four key shapes: circle, square, vertical rectangle and horizontal rectangle. These fundamental shapes help us maintain consistency across all system icons.
For example, the following icons share the same fundamental circle shape and should be constructed based on the circle key shape.
All icons should be placed at the center of the grid. However, perfectly centered alignment doesn’t always work. It’s important to optically align them instead to achieve the most balanced placement.
Maintain the same visual weight by using a 2px centered stroke for all icons.
If a certain system icon has complex details, stroke size should be adjusted to improve visual balance.

When converting a line icon to a filled icon, stroke size may be adjusted to create a stronger contrast and emphasis on the primary symbol. 

For example, in the below icon: Exclamation-circle (Filled), the stroke size of the exclamation mark is adjusted from 2px to 2.5px.
Line and Filled icons are constructed based on different stroke alignments. As a result, the corner radius is therefore varied. To further understand this, please use the following examples:
For complex icons, icons with smaller shapes, we recommend reducing corner radius to sharpen the design.
Slashes should go from top left to bottom right and cutouts should follow the stroke size of the system icon.

Modifiers are small icons which are drawn on a particular base icon to indicate action or  additional information. The most common examples are plus icon to indicate add action; heart icon to indicate follow, add to favorite, subscribe action and many more.
The modifier icon shape should follow the base icon type.
For filled modifier, they should be drawn on a 12x12px grid frame. Each frame includes 1px padding on all sides as guidance.
The cutout separates the modifier from the base icon. To create the cutout, please use a 1.5 pixel outer stroke outline and substract from the base icon.

Modifier frame should be overlaid on the bottom right of the icon. However, this placement may not work at all times. If the modifiers hide the key details of a certain system icon, we can consider a different corner.

It is okay to place the modifier onto the padding but it should not exceed more than 1 pixel from the base icon live area.

If there isn’t a right placement for the modifier, we can consider creating a new system icon that combined both the meanings of the base icon and the modifier.

Please see the icon below for example. Instead of overlaying the modifier on the base icon, placing the plus icon inside the base icon would be more reasonable. We don’t need to cut out any detail from the base icon and it looks more visually balanced.
A few adjustment can be made in order to simplify the overall look without affecting the original meaning of the base icon.

As the product grows, more and more icons will be added into the system. We tried:
Naming icons with -alt or adding numbers;
Or naming icons with various rules: after objects, after actions, or descriptors.
Those were not effective. We need a proper naming method in order to provide consistency and guessability throughout all icons.
If the icon includes modifiers, variants or alternatives. The priority of naming should follow as the order below and is separated by a hyphen (-):
Icon naming should base on its object, how it looks rather than its action, how it represents in the designs.
If an icon is based on a key shape or a certain geometric shape: circle, rectangle, triangle; name the primary object first.
If an icon have modifier, or is created based on the original icon with more details to enhance its meaning, the modifier's name is suffixed to the primary icon's name.
Arrow/chevron icons name should always contain the direction they are pointing.
If possible, include the destination to provide further information.
The same goes with modifiers and off icons. Name them by object-based, not their usage.
If an icon contains more than 2 objects and there’s a clear hierrachy between the primary and secondary objects, name the primary object first, follow by the remaining ones.
If there’s no clear hierrachy between objects, objects are similar in size, name the objects starting from left to right, from top to bottom.
Even though we’ve established naming an icon by its action, there’s certain situation we can name it by action. For instance, icon that implies movement:
If there are more than 2 duplicated objects within an icon, add -s to make plural nouns instead of repeating the same words.

There are certain icons that are originally created for a particular purpose and are well-known for their speciality, everyone knows what it means, and what it does. In this case, let’s name the icon by its globalized meaning. It’s confusing when we try to name it by object-based.
It’s a good thing to follow the rules, but it’s not always effective. If the icon name is too long, we will consider replacing its name with its most well-known usage/definition.
To provide convenience and further information for each icons, the usage, action or related keywords will then be added to the description.

Định dạng: PNG
Bounding box: 48x48 px
Display area: 44x44 px
Khoảng an toàn: 2px

Nhóm Blue - Orange 
Phân loại sử dụng: Di động, Nạp tiền & Data, Sim số, Internet & Truyền hình

Nhóm Blue - Green
Phân loại sử dụng: Du lịch, Hoá đơn, Hỗ trợ

Lưu ý khi sử dụng: 
Sử dụng tối đa 2–3 màu trên mỗi icon. VNPT Blue là màu chủ đạo, màu còn lại làm điểm nhấn.
 Hạn chế gradient phức tạp và đảm bảo tính đồng nhất trong từng nhóm icon.
 Dễ nhận diện ở kích thước nhỏ, tránh sử dụng quá nhiều chi tiết.

Quy tắc  sử dụng: 
Logo đối tác: Giữ nguyên logo gốc của đối tác, không thay đổi màu sắc hoặc tỷ lệ. Khi đặt sử dụng logo của thương hiệu khác, làm theo các bước sau:
       - Đặt logo trong 1 frame kích thước 48x48px, nền background trắng có stroke 1px - màu #EDEDED
       - Đặt hình ảnh logo kích thước 36x36 px và bo góc tròn vào chính giữa frame
Thương hiệu thuộc hệ sinh thái VNPT: Ưu tiên sử dụng icon theo Design System My VNPT để đảm bảo tính nhất quán giao diện.
